artworks.title: Looking Northwest from Westminster Street, Providence
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.description: The image shows a densely packed urban area from a high vantage point. The horizon is near the top edge, with buildings and homes tightly packed together. Various architectural features like pitched roofs and chimneys are visible. In the distance, the ground levels off, possibly indicating flat plains or water. The image is monochromatic, focusing on shades of gray and sepia tones. Rooftops dominate the foreground, with structures becoming smaller and less defined in the distance, showing depth in the composition.

artworks.title: Hyacinthe Rigaud
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a half-body portrait seated in a slightly turned position. He has a composed expression with facial features, including a prominent nose and a faintly arched brow. His hair is mostly concealed under a hat. The man is dressed in a draped garment resembling traditional artist's attire, with layers and gathered fabric. He holds a palette with paint dabs and brushes in his left hand, indicating his profession or interest as a painter. The background includes architectural details like a column or wall to the right, suggesting an indoor setting with classical design elements. Shadows and detailed textures of the garments and background add depth to the portrait.

artworks.title: France Crowned with Victory by Louis XIV
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper  [artist's working proof]
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 38.4 × 252 cm (15 1/8 × 99 3/16 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.description: This is a drawing filled with classical elements and allegorical figures. It features various characters engaging in activities like writing, reading, and presenting or crowning. Surrounding them are symbolic elements such as laurel wreaths, musical instruments, and mythological motifs. The central part of the image shows a framed scene of a grand hall with more figures possibly reenacting a historic or allegorical moment. The figures have muscular physiques and are intertwined in a dynamic pose, typical of Baroque-style engravings. One figure at the bottom left has wings and a scythe, possibly symbolizing the passage of time. The drawing evokes themes from mythology or classical literature.

artworks.title: Von Storch Shaft, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: This photograph displays a landscape scene from an elevated viewpoint. Closest to us is a field with a slightly patchy texture, bordered by a horizontal wooden fence. A person dressed in black stands near the fence on the left, their back to us. A large, wooden building with a mix of vertical and angular lines is to the left of center, behind the fence. The building has an asymmetrical shape and seems to be connected to some smaller sheds or other structures. In the background, a small town is surrounded by gently rolling hills. The low horizon reveals faint outlines of more distant hills or mountains. The sky is clear, although smoke or fog seems to cover some of the distant mountains. Below the photograph are two lines of text.

artworks.title: Von Storch Breaker, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a wooden structure resembling an incline railway or conveyor leading towards a large building complex in the distance. A light haze obscures the horizon, hinting at an expansive forested area and other buildings. Trees on the sides blur softly, suggesting movement. A river with reflective waters flows close by. The setting appears historical and industrial, with a monochromatic color palette in shades of sepia and grey, giving it a vintage feel.

artworks.title: Silver Springs, Florida
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with an elevated point of view, possibly taken from a higher position. There are trees with thin trunks and Spanish moss in the background, partially obscuring the horizon. In the water, some small boats and a steamboat are visible, with smoke coming from the steamboat's chimney. The image has a sepia tone, giving it a vintage look, and a color palette of browns and beiges. In the distance, there is a train track, a wooden structure, and a few figures engaging in various activities.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene with heavenly figures and a textual introduction. The drawing features a winged figure holding a crown in the sky and another character blowing a trumpet. The sky has soft clouds. Below is text in French mentioning artists and locations.

artworks.title: Frontispiece
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental coat of arms. The design includes a central shield with heraldic symbols, two cherubic figures, each with an arm on a lion, and detailed decorations such as musical instruments, scrolls, and feathers. A banner with Latin inscriptions is at the top, and the composition is framed by scrollwork with text below.

artworks.title: Ornamental Panel Surmounted by a Winged Harpy
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate and allegorical scene with detailed figures, scrolls, and emblems. The drawing features a landscape scene within a central hexagonal frame. Surrounded by decorations, cherubic figures, and mythical creatures including winged figures and animals, it conveys a rich sense of baroque ornamentation. Above the central hexagon is a circular medallion showing a classical scene. The drawing incorporates swirling motifs and wreaths, contributing to its grandeur and complexity.

artworks.title: Ornamental Panel with Pan and Two Garland-Bearing Women
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This image is a drawing of a decorative composition featuring elaborate ornamentation and a central vignette of landscape. The drawing consists of a vertically oriented rectangular design that showcases an opulent and intricate arrangement of elements typical of Baroque or Rococo ornamentation. In the very center, there is an oval frame encasing a simple landscape scene with a tree and a pastoral view beyond. This is surrounded by an ornate border with symmetrical scrollwork, floral motifs, and festoons. Two reclining figures are depicted at the top corners, each holding decorative elements. Below the landscape vignette is a horizontal panel depicting a classical scene with several figures engaged in interaction. The drawing displays a harmonious blend of nature and mythological elements, rendered with detailed and elegant linework.

artworks.title: Ornamental Panel Surmounted by a Medallion with a Sacrifice
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate engraving featuring elaborate ornamentation and figures. The viewpoint is straight on, centered on a vertically oriented rectangular frame. Two winged figures are positioned on either side, one holding a horn and the other arranging garlands of leaves. In the center, a large medallion displays a landscape scene with a pathway winding through leafy trees. The horizon in the landscape portion is low to emphasize the towering trees. Above, a large heraldic display conveys regality, while below, additional mythical figures frame the scene. The color palette is black and white, showcasing the detailed textures and flowing lines of the engraving with rich contrasts and careful shading.

artworks.title: Ornamental Panel Surmounted by the Crowned Head of a Woman and Two Peacocks
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features an elaborate design with classical elements and ornate detailing. Symmetrical arrangements include two birds, a mask-like face, floral motifs, and an oval scene with mythological or allegorical content. A central rectangular frame holds a small landscape scene with trees and a possible body of water. The bottom portion has decorative scrolls and winged putti figures. The palette is monochromatic in detailed black ink, creating contrast and depth with varied textures.

artworks.title: Ornamental Panel Surmounted by an Eagle and the Motto NATOS ET NOSTRA TUEMUR
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing features an elaborate decorative motif with mythological and heraldic elements. It shows a symmetrical composition with a central oval medallion framed ornately. Two winged figures are positioned symmetrically at the top, holding garlands and standing on scrolls. An eagle above them holds a banner with the inscription 'NATOS ET NOSTRA IUVENTA'. Below the central medallion is a shell design flanked by seated figures holding flowers, set against a background of baroque scrollwork and foliage. Below the shell is a rectangular panel with a relief scene of classical figures. The composition is detailed with elements of nature and classical architecture.

artworks.title: Ornamental Panel Surmounted by a Basket of Flowers with Cupid and Hymen
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate decorative design. The artwork features a central panel with a tree against a landscape surrounded by scrollwork. Various figures, including cherubs and mythological beings, interact with architectural and floral elements. At the top, two cherubic figures interact with a central medallion encircled by foliage. Below, two muscular figures hold garlands for balance. The lower portion showcases a scene of figures and animals within a richly embellished rectangular frame.

artworks.title: Ornamental Panel Surmounted with Two Figures Leaning on the Bust of a Woman
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraving seen straight on. There are two winged figures at the top, above a scene of two people at a table within a wreath. Below, a frame contains a rural landscape with a tree on the right and hills in the distance. The image features detailed line work and shading for texture and depth, with a monochromatic color scheme of black and white. Two seated figures sit near an urn with drapery and scrollwork around them.

artworks.title: Ornamental Panel Surmounted by a Basket of Flowers and a Garland
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a vertical decorative arrangement with symmetry. Two cherubic figures are holding a framed central image featuring a landscape with trees and a distant horizon. The frame is ornate with scrollwork and floral motifs. Above the central frame, two peacocks are perched on decorative elements, surrounded by foliage and flowers. The engraving shows detailed linework with hatching and cross-hatching for texture. The color palette is monochrome in black and white, highlighting the contrast and craftsmanship. In the framed image, a faint horizon with clouds above trees provides a tranquil backdrop.

artworks.title: Ornamental Panel Surmounted with a Head Flanked by Foliage
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative classical scene with architectural elements. The image features an ornamental design with a central oval frame depicting a landscape view of ancient ruins and trees. Above the central frame is a sculpted head surrounded by intricate scrollwork. Two putti are positioned on either side near the top, holding garlands, which extend vertically and frame the drawing. Below the central oval, two draped figures, one on each side, appear to be interacting with the garland. The figures rest on an ornate base that includes motifs of classical architecture and decorative arts.

artworks.title: Ornamental Panel Surmounted by Two Putti and a Vase
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate allegorical scene with cherubs, a decorative urn, and classical figures. The image features symmetrical composition. At the top, two cherubs are holding a ribbon attached to an ornamental urn on a pedestal with floral motifs. Below the urn, within a decorative frame, are two classical figures. One figure is crowned with rays of light, sitting on a cloud, holding draped cloth, and reaching towards the other dynamic figure. At the base, there are two classical, partially draped figures supporting the composition. The piece is bordered with elaborate scrollwork and foliage.

artworks.title: Ornamental Panel Surmounted by a Maritime Scene and a Shell
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a tree, hills in the distance, and an elaborate border surrounding the scene. The artwork is monochrome with fine engraving lines highlighting details of classical figures and ornate elements.

artworks.title: Ornamental Panel Surmounted by a Bust of a Woman and Two Putti with Flaming Trumpets
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural and ornamental design with cherubs and classical elements. The central image depicts a neoclassical structure with columns, surrounded by borders, floral wreaths, and various figures. At the top, two winged cherubs are positioned on either side of a medallion adorned with a floral wreath containing a profile portrait. Below the central landscape are two cherubs seated on mythical creatures resembling sea horses. The use of shading and line work creates depth and texture, particularly in the detailed wreath and the flowing drapery of the figures. The design suggests a blend of mythological, architectural, and decorative motifs.

artworks.title: Ornamental Panel Surmounted by a Naiad and a River God
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural design with classical motifs. The image features an intricate design showcasing classical architecture with a focus on decorative and allegorical elements. An octagonal panel in the center depicts a scene of architectural ruins with arches and columns. Surrounding this central image are elaborately designed figures that resemble Classical or Roman deities and allegorical figures, draped in flowing garments. Above and below the main panel, there are additional decorative elements, including more human figures in reclining positions who are adorned with laurel wreaths. The entire composition is symmetrical, with ornate borders and embellishments that enhance the sense of grandeur and elegance.

artworks.title: Le Lutrin: A  Night Scene with Boirude, Brontin, and L'Amour Surprised by an Owl Flying Out of a Lectern
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash, heightened with white, indented for transfer with the verso blackened, and the border on an attached sheet of paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring intricate surroundings and furniture. The central scene displays three individuals in period attire interacting in a room. Two hold lit candles, and a bird is featured on a pedestal-like structure. The room includes decorative paneling and detailed furnishings. The border presents owls, books, papers, celestial embellishments, and a cherub playing a musical instrument. An open book with musical notations is also included in the ornate frame.

artworks.title: Panoramic View of Washington, DC
artworks.medium: 5 albumen silver prints
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Wolf and Mathew Wolf in memory of Diane Wolf
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape from an elevated viewpoint, featuring various urban structures and land. The horizon is high in the composition, with a body of water to the left and a building with a dome to the right. Various architecture and greenery can be seen, transitioning from trees and pathways in the foreground to dense urban development in the distance. The color palette is muted with sepia tones, creating a vintage aesthetic.

artworks.title: A Fan with Classical Figures Processing to Apollo
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint and roulette printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 49.2 × 24.4 cm (19 3/8 × 9 5/8 in.) (cut inside platemark and measured at widest points)
artworks.description: This drawing features a fan-shaped design with classical figures and floral motifs. It has a semi-circular composition inspired by historical or mythological themes. The segments contain detailed illustrations of figures in different poses wearing classical drapery. The outer and inner bands display intricate floral and geometric patterns framing the figures. The central portion of the fan is mostly empty, placing focus on the decorated borders. The drawing uses a monochromatic tone to highlight the fine line work and detailed decorations reminiscent of classical antiquity.
